xxHash: Yann Collet's xxHash family — among the fastest non-cryptographic hashes available, with excellent distribution. Pick `xxh3_64` as a modern default; the 128-bit variants give you an extra-large hash space when collisions are a concern.
RapidHash: RapidHash is purpose-built for raw speed while keeping distribution quality. One of the fastest published 64-bit hash algorithms — use when xxHash's speed isn't enough.
MurmurHash3: MurmurHash3 is a battle-tested non-cryptographic hash widely used in distributed systems (Cassandra, Redis, Spark). Choose this when you need to interoperate with another tool that already uses MurmurHash3.
